summary: Explains selecting variables, files or templates by fact: name files after the differentiating fact and choose them with a variable based on it, keeping playbooks free of nested conditionals.
questions: How do I handle different package names across CentOS and Debian cleanly?
How do I pick a different template per OS without lots of when statements?

answer_card.title: Selecting vars, files or templates by fact
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Name your vars files, templates or files after the fact that differs (for example `RedHat.yml`, `Debian.yml`).
2. Select the right one per host with a variable built from that fact.

This keeps variables separate from tasks and avoids nested conditionals.
